_comment: Reviewable classification and exclusion configuration for bound-molecule annotations (Milestone 3B). Every rule applied by rna_explorer.annotations is listed here; nothing is hardcoded in the module.

bound_molecule_classes._comment: CCD ids are matched exactly (case-insensitive). Anything not listed is class 'ligand'. Lists are deliberately broad so that other families reuse them; entries not present in a family are simply unused.

artefact_rules.description: The bound-molecule CCD id is also a residue of the contacted RNA polymer sequence (e.g. a 5'-terminal GTP incorporated during in vitro transcription). PDBe reports such covalently attached components as bound molecules; they are retained with this flag and excluded from the default ligand track.

All contacted polymer positions lie within 'terminal_window' residues of a polymer terminus (e.g. GTP reported against the 5'-terminal G of in vitro transcribed RNA). Flagged as a possible terminal-nucleotide or crystallisation artefact and excluded from the default ligand track; retained in ligands.json and per-instance records. DECISION FOR SCIENTIFIC REVIEW: set to false to keep such molecules in the default track.
